name: browser-automation-studio.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every row of browser-automation-studio's improve setpoint in one submission and report each as in band, out of band, or unavailable, without estimating.

evidence_sample.description: Failed executions whose screenshots are counted (0..10).

profile.description: Operations reads historical usage diagnostics; rehabilitation preserves every required browser-product outcome and explicit measurement gap.

assumptions: the caller treats an unavailable row as unknown, never as zero
executions list is a fleet-wide list ordered newest first
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no row set is materialized beyond evidence_sample rows; readings are count and filter
a row whose sensor has no governed binding is reported unavailable with the reason, not computed by hand
passive-fidelity, profile-durability, cancellation-recovery, and resource-budget use their own provider maturity capability from the exact current rehabilitation phase
capture and rehabilitation owner readings must match the live managed BAS build identity
rehabilitation rows are unavailable unless lifecycle freshness proves every managed BAS artifact is current
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
no setpoint row is computed by hand from files; a row without a governed sensor reads unavailable with the reason
rehabilitation rows cover every required REFRACTOR_CONTRACT.json outcome
product_qualified is false while any required outcome lacks applicable owner evidence
no caller-supplied pass flags or receipts can certify rehabilitation

signals.rows: Fleet setpoint rows. For rehabilitation, target is an immutable contract-id/row reference into docs/internal/REFRACTOR_CONTRACT.json; unavailable rows never count as satisfied.
signals.readable: count of rows read from a governed binding
signals.unavailable: count of rows not readable in-program
signals.required: Required rehabilitation outcome count, only for rehabilitation profile
signals.unmet: Required outcomes without passing applicable evidence
signals.product_qualified: False until all required outcomes have qualified owner evidence

outputs.evidence: sensor command names, one per row

budget.async_reason: The desktop/browser setpoint read waits on external owner conditions and may reach the synchronous invoke ceiling; callers wait once for its terminal result.
